reason: Integrates a configured sub2api gateway with DeepSeek Harness, exposing multiple model-provider routes plus model discovery, usage lookup, streaming chat, and configured image tools.

summaries.zh: 将配置好的 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供多平台模型路由、模型发现、用量查询、流式聊天以及图像分析和生成工具。
summaries.en: Connects a configured sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness for multi-provider model routes, model discovery, usage lookup, streaming chat, and image analysis and generation tools.

capabilities: Connects to a configured sub2api gateway as an LLM provider
Registers provider routes for OpenAI, Claude, Grok, and Gemini model groups
Fetches model catalogs and usage information from the gateway
Supports streaming chat, tool calls, reasoning effort, image analysis, and image generation through configured models
Stores and references provider credentials through the harness credential service
